name: Icebound
source:
Icebound is a dark fantasy, mystery visual novel that takes place in a world locked in the depths of an ice age. It features a non-linear plot with multiple endings, romance, and puzzle game elements.

On the world of Permia, two races, human and feran, share a fragile peace. In the north resides the Holy Empire, whose machinery and society both run like clockwork, and in the south, the Council, a powerful alliance of tribes who have mastered the spiritual arts. In this world, there exists the ability to manipulate the forces of nature - only those who can master their training and summon a Familiar can receive the title of "alchemist".

A wandering alchemist named Dougal winds up in the isolated town of Isenbarr with his Familiar, Isaac, hoping to find a job and earn some spending money. But when he stumbles across a lucrative challenge offered by a master alchemist and his clockwork beast, he must compete with three other unique individuals to obtain the powerful Philosopher's Stone. In his search for a deadly monster, Dougal discovers truths that might be better off hidden, and a secret agent whose mission is all but clear...
translation:
《冰封》是一部黑暗奇幻、悬疑视觉小说，故事发生在冰河时代深处的世界。它具有非线性情节、多个结局、浪漫和益智游戏元素。

在佩尔米亚世界上，人类和费拉两个种族共享着脆弱的和平。北方居住着神圣帝国，其机器和社会都像发条一样运转；而南方则居住着议会，一个由掌握灵术的部落组成的强大联盟。在这个世界上，存在着操纵自然力量的能力——只有那些能够掌握自然力量并召唤出御兽的人，才能获得“炼金术士”的称号。

一位名叫杜格尔（Dougal）的流浪炼金术士和他的宠儿艾萨克（Isaac）来到了偏僻的小镇艾森巴尔（Isenbarr），希望能找到一份工作并赚点零用钱。但当他偶然发现炼金大师和他的发条野兽提出的利润丰厚的挑战时，他必须与其他三个独特的人竞争以获得强大的贤者之石。在寻找致命怪物的过程中，杜格尔发现了隐藏起来可能更好的真相，以及一名任务几乎明确的特工……
